status: Working vocabulary: descriptive terms and teaching exercises, not universal meanings or an exhaustive taxonomy.

terms.name: Flow
terms.observation: Continuous paths with a changing direction.
terms.mechanism: A field gives each position a direction; paths follow it.
terms.question: Does the motion read as water, wind, handwriting or something else? Which context makes that reading possible?

terms.name: Cohesion
terms.observation: Separate marks gather into locally coherent groups.
terms.question: Does grouping suggest cooperation, crowding, control or care? What changes your reading?

terms.name: Interference
terms.observation: Overlapping rhythms form larger apparent bands.
terms.mechanism: Two repeated structures interact through angle, spacing and phase.
terms.question: When does repetition feel orderly, unstable, optical or mechanical?

terms.name: Branching
terms.observation: A structure divides repeatedly across scales.
terms.mechanism: Recursive rules extend and split a structure.
terms.question: Does the same branching form read as a plant, a family, a route or a hierarchy? Why?

terms.name: Grain
terms.observation: Many small marks build a larger tonal impression.
terms.mechanism: Discrete marks distribute density or brightness.
terms.question: Does grain suggest print, memory, noise or material? Which associations come from experience?

terms.name: Subdivision
terms.observation: A whole separates into nested regions.
terms.mechanism: A partition rule repeatedly divides an area.
terms.question: Does a partition read as architecture, territory, a grid or an organism? What makes it feel imposed or grown?

attribution: Recipe links trace specific contributions. They do not imply that an individual invented an aesthetic quality, or that visual similarity establishes influence.
